title: Discovered and double check
line: The uncovered piece gives check, so the moving piece can take anything; when both give check, only a king move answers it.

steps.text: Your knight stands between your rook and the black king. Wherever the knight goes, the rook gives check.
Move the knight and take the queen. The check from the rook comes with it.
steps.hint: The knight can capture the queen in one jump.
steps.after: Black had to answer the check, and the queen was gone.

steps.text: A double check is two checks at once. No block or capture can stop both, so only the king can move.
Give double check: the knight checks the king, and so does the rook behind it.
steps.hint: Find a knight jump that attacks the king.
steps.after: Two checks, and the king has no square: checkmate.

summary: When moving a piece uncovers check, the moving piece is free. When both pieces give check, only the king can move.
